newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Minotaur finds Gawler gold anomalies.
newsitem.headline: Minotaur finds Gawler gold anomalies.

text.p: Minotaur Gold NL said on Tuesday that a drilling program at the Birthday Prospect in South Australia's highly prospective Gawler Craton exploration area had outlined four significant gold anomalies.
In a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange, Minotaur said the anomalies lie within a larger zone where scattered bedrock finds occur over two kilometres.
Maximum assay results from the shallow drill holes were 1.2 grams per tonne gold, 0.5 g/t, 0.7 g/t and 1.1 g/t.
The company said reverse circulation drilling to test the zones of anomalous gold at depth was planned to commence on December 16 with results to be assessed in late February, 1997.
Over the same period further rotary air blast drilling was to occur to test additional anomalous gold targets in the Commonwealth Hill area, Minotaur said.
Participants in the Commonwealth Hill tenements are Minotaur with 70 percent and a unit Lakes Oil NL with 30 percent.
Minotaur shares closed steady on 75 cents with turnover of 465,459 shares.
